items.title: Tell HN: Litellm 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 on PyPI are compromised
items.raw_content: About an hour ago new versions have been deployed to PyPI. I was just setting up a new project, and things behaved weirdly. My laptop ran out of RAM, it looked like a forkbomb was running. I've investigated, and found that a base64 encoded blob has been added to proxy_server.py. It writes and decodes another file which it then runs. I'm in the process of reporting this upstream, but wanted to give everyone here a headsup. It is also reported in this issue: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/24512
items.title_zh: Tell HN：PyPI 上的 Litellm 1.82.7 和 1.82.8 已遭投毒
items.summary: A Hacker News poster reports that LiteLLM 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 on PyPI contain a base64-encoded blob in proxy_server.py that decodes and runs another file, after their laptop behaved oddly as if a forkbomb were running; the issue was being reported upstream.

items.summary: Citing Citrini Research, the post argues that the US economy built a vast rent-extraction layer on human limitations such as limited time, patience and brand familiarity, and that trillions of dollars of enterprise value depended on those constraints persisting.

items.title: Manifold Generalization Provably Proceeds Memorization in Diffusion Models
items.title_zh: 扩散模型中流形泛化可证明地先于记忆化发生
items.summary: Under the manifold hypothesis, the paper shows that diffusion models trained with coarse scores can exploit the regularity of the manifold support to reach a near-parametric rate toward a different target distribution, explaining how they generate novel samples; when the manifold is sufficiently smooth, generalization occurs at a statistical rate strictly faster than that required to estimate the full population distribution.

items.title: Greedy Is a Strong Default: Agents as Iterative Optimizers
items.title_zh: 贪心就是强默认：把 Agent 当作迭代优化器
items.summary: The authors replace random candidate generation in classical optimization with an LLM agent that draws on evaluation feedback, and conclude that simple greedy hill climbing plus early stopping is a strong default across four tasks.

items.title: Near-Optimal Primal-Dual Algorithm for Learning Linear Mixture CMDPs with Adversarial Rewards
items.title_zh: 学习带对抗性奖励的线性混合 CMDP 的近最优原始-对偶算法
items.summary: The paper proposes a primal-dual policy optimization algorithm for safe RL in finite-horizon linear-mixture constrained MDPs with adversarial rewards, full-information feedback and no prior knowledge of the transition kernel. The authors say that, to their knowledge, it is the first provably efficient algorithm for this setting, and report a near-optimal regret bound.

items.title: A Vision Language Model for Generating Procedural Plant Architecture Representations from Simulated Images
items.title_zh: 从模拟图像生成程序化植物结构表示的视觉语言模型
items.summary: The authors trained a vision-language model to generate token sequences encoding a procedural 3D plant architecture from synthetic cowpea images produced with the Helios simulator, reaching a token F1 of 0.73 in teacher-forced training and a BLEU-4 of 94.00% in autoregressive evaluation.

items.title: Retinal Disease Classification from Fundus Images using CNN Transfer Learning
items.title_zh: 基于 CNN 迁移学习的眼底图像视网膜疾病分类
items.summary: The paper presents a reproducible pipeline for binary retinal disease risk classification from public fundus photographs, comparing a baseline CNN with a pretrained VGG16 transfer-learning model; VGG16 reached 90.8% test accuracy and a weighted F1 of 0.90 versus 83.1% for the baseline, while sensitivity to minority disease cases remained a challenge.

items.title: FireBridge: Cycle-Accurate Hardware + Firmware Co-Verification for Modern Accelerators
items.title_zh: FireBridge：面向现代加速器的周期精确硬件与固件协同验证
items.summary: FireBridge is a cycle-accurate co-verification framework that bridges production firmware with RTL and gate-level hardware using standard simulators, enabling firmware debugging and profiling in seconds. The authors report up to 50x faster debug iterations than a conventional FPGA-based flow for accelerators such as systolic arrays and CGRAs.

items.title: GIFT: Bootstrapping Image-to-CAD Program Synthesis via Geometric Feedback
items.title_zh: GIFT：利用几何反馈自举图像到 CAD 的程序合成
items.summary: GIFT uses geometric feedback to convert inference-time search into additional training data for image-to-CAD program synthesis; it reports a 12% mean IoU gain over a supervised baseline and 80% less inference compute.

items.title: Spectral Signatures of Data Quality: Eigenvalue Tail Index as a Diagnostic for Label Noise in Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 数据质量的谱特征：以特征值尾部指数诊断神经网络标签噪声
items.summary: Under controlled label noise, the tail index of the eigenvalue distribution at a network's bottleneck layer predicts test accuracy with a leave-one-out R-squared of 0.984, far above conventional baselines, the author reports. Under hyperparameter variation at fixed data quality, however, spectral and conventional measures are all weak predictors, so the paper frames the index as a label-noise diagnostic rather than a universal generalization predictor.

items.title: The Cognitive Firewall:Securing Browser Based AI Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injection Via Hybrid Edge Cloud Defense
items.title_zh: 认知防火墙：以混合边缘-云防御保护浏览器 AI 代理免受间接提示注入
items.summary: The paper presents Cognitive Firewall, a three-stage split-compute architecture with a local visual Sentinel, a cloud Deep Planner and a deterministic Guard, to defend browser-based LLM agents against indirect prompt injection; across 1,000 adversarial samples the full hybrid reduced the attack success rate below 1%, while edge-only defenses missed 86.9% of semantic attacks, and local filtering gave roughly a 17,000x latency advantage over cloud-only baselines.

items.title: Evaluating Large and Lightweight Vision Models for Irregular Component Segmentation in E-Waste Disassembly
items.title_zh: 电子垃圾拆解中不规则部件分割：大型与轻量视觉模型评估
items.summary: The study compares SAM2 with the lightweight YOLOv8 on 1,456 annotated images of laptop components for robotic e-waste disassembly; YOLOv8 reached 98.8% mAP50 and 85% mAP50-95, while SAM2 reached 8.4% mAP50.
